findings.evidence: never run a bare `gh pr view --repo`. ... Never pass `--repo` to `gh api`.

findings.evidence: No frontmatter; the host falls back to the first body line '# PR workflow', which has no WHAT detail, no WHEN and no keywords

Flags: --diagrams=none|mermaid|drawio, --reuse-from=<PR>, --base=<branch>.
